[[Beggen]] | capacity = {{nts|4900}}{{cite web |title=Fiche Football Club Avenir Beggen|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/FootballFicheClub1655.html |website=[[L'Équipe]] |access-date=28 April 2025 |lang=fr |trans-title=Dossier FC Avenir Beggen}} | chairman = Damien Raths{{cite web |title=Organigram |url=https://www.wichtelweb.net/organigramm/ |website=FC Avenir Beggen |access-date=11 February 2026 |language=fr |trans-title=Organisational chart}} | chrtitle = President | manager = Marcin Siebert{{cite web |title=Éischt Ekipp |url=https://www.wichtelweb.net/eischt-ekipp/|website=Avenir Beggen (Wichtelweb) |access-date=4 December 2025 |language=lb |date=19 September 2025 |trans-title=First team}} | league = {{Luxembourg football updater|AVB1}} | season = {{Luxembourg football updater|AVB2}} | position = {{Luxembourg football updater|AVB3}} | website = {{Official URL}} | pattern_la1 = _blackshoulders | pattern_b1 = _blackshoulders | pattern_ra1 = _blackshoulders | leftarm1 = EEEE00 | body1 = EEEE00 | rightarm1 = EEEE00 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 000000 | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000| }} '''Football Club Avenir Beggen''' is a [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[Beggen]], [[Luxembourg City|Luxembourg]]. They currently compete in the [[Luxembourg Division of Honour|Division of Honour]], the second tier of Luxembourgish football. The club were founded in 1915{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/luxembourg/fc-avenir-beggen/1421/|title=FC Avenir Beggen|publisher=Soccerway|language=en|access-date=13 November 2015}} as '''FC Daring Beggen''' but changed their name to '''FC Avenir Beggen''' a year later. In 1940, they were renamed '''SV 1915 Beggen''', but in 1944, it was changed again to '''FC Avenir Beggen'''. Avenir Beggen had played in the [[Luxembourg National Division|National Division]] in consecutive seasons since 1965–66, but were relegated in the [[Luxembourg National Division 2005-06|2005–06 season]]. Finishing second in their first season in the second-tier [[Luxembourg Division of Honour|Division of Honour]], Avenir returned to the National Division at the first time of asking. In 2008/09 the club finished 14th and were relegated back to the [[Luxembourg Division of Honour]]."}}
